Non-Structural / Hairline Crack — Seal & Observe.
  1. Map crack pattern to classify (shrinkage, thermal, or settlement origin).
  2. For cracks < 0.2 mm width: apply flexible polyurethane or epoxy crack sealer.
  3. For cracks 0.2–0.3 mm: route and seal using V-groove cutting and elastomeric sealant.
  4. Apply waterproof crystalline coating to prevent water ingress and rebar corrosion.
  5. Schedule 6-monthly monitoring; escalate if crack width increases by > 0.05 mm.
  Ref: IS 456 Table 20 / ACI 224R
